content.scopeOfRegistration: The scope of the ISO 9001:2015 certification is limited to the quality management system (QMS) supporting the operations of the Global Security Executive Protection (GSEP), Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), Physical Security Operations (PSO), and Data Centers Physical Security (DCPS) teams.

The scope of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification is limited to the information security management system (ISMS) supporting the development, operation, and maintenance of MM Lite API, Business AI, Meta Model API, and WhatsApp Pay India, hosted by Meta, and in accordance with the statement of applicability, dated September 8, 2026.

The scope of the ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification is limited to the artificial intelligence management system (AIMS) supporting the delivery of Meta Business Agent services, in the role of AI Provider, and in accordance with the statement of applicability, dated September 1, 2026. This AIMS applies to information resources, processes, and personnel related to delivering Meta Business Agent. Information resources include Meta-owned or Meta-managed systems, applications, and network elements, in addition to data collected or used in delivering Meta Business Agent services. The underlying large language models are explicitly excluded from this scope.

The scope of the ISO/IEC 27018:2025 certification covers the control objectives, controls and guidelines for implementing measures to protect personally identifiable information (PII) in accordance with the privacy principles in ISO/IEC 29100 for the Meta Horizon Managed Solutions and Workplace Product which includes Workplace, Managed Meta Accounts, and Horizon Managed Services and all related supporting technology and in accordance with the statement of applicability, dated June 22, 2026.
